title: Don Possible NDE 6493
content: It is only recently that I have recalled this event and I do not know why. Maybe it's because I have been left with a sense of confusion. During my surgery, I became aware of myself, walking in a grassy clearing that was surrounded by trees. At the time, I thought that I was seeing a light-grey sky in the distance. But now, I believe it was a dim light. As I continued looking at it, the light became a pure white. I wanted to go there, to where the white light was, and so I kept walking toward it. As I walked, I noticed how lush and green the grass and the forest were. I was at peace and I felt content. Then, I heard dogs barking and I could understand what they were saying! They were playing, and planning to go somewhere to continue their game. I turned a corner and there was the group of dogs! I became very joyful when I saw that two of my deceased dogs were part of the group! I called out the name of one of my dogs, wanting to hold and pet him. The other dogs took off, racing towards the light. My dog turned, looked right at me and barked. And again, I could understand him. In a very scolding tone he said, 'You're not supposed to be here!' He took off and joined the other dogs, and soon they were all engulfed by the light. I could see figures there, but I could not move. It was then that I woke up. Since the surgery and near death experience, my life has been something of a struggle. To this day, I am haunted by that experience. I pray and mediate, wondering why it had not been my time, and why I was 'not supposed to be there.' Also, the doctors said that my surgery had been complication-free. No mention of my heart stopping.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of dogs, including two deceased dogs of the experiencer; figures were also seen in/near the light but not identified.

environment.environment_other_detail: Grassy clearing surrounded by trees/forest; light-grey sky/dim light in the distance that became pure white; lush green grass and forest.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Communication with barking dogs that the experiencer could understand; inability to move when seeing figures near the light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience began directly in a grassy clearing (no OBE/tunnel described), then movement toward a light, encounter/communication with dogs, verbal prohibition ('You're not supposed to be here!'), then abrupt waking/return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Encounter and communication with a group of dogs; two were deceased pets; dogs ran into and were engulfed by the white light; figures were seen in/near the light but not identified; experiencer reported being unable to move at that point.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: In a very scolding tone he said, 'You're not supposed to be here!'
